skill_name: Describe the narrative structure of film Casablanca
workflow: The narrative structure of the film Casablanca follows a story arc of rising conflict, which eventually culminates in a climax and resolution. The film begins with Rick and Ilsa in Paris as their love story blossoms, only to be interrupted by the Nazi forces surrounding them. The central conflict of the film kicks in as Rick and Ilsa are reunited in Casablanca and Ilsa wants to leave with her husband, Laszlo, who is on a mission to help the resistance movement against Nazi rule.
